redCandidate.publicEntry: AIOS init/setup/update lifecycle commands and the standalone Rex workflow-surface reconciler
redCandidate.setup: Run the CLI parser, lifecycle adapters, and standalone reconciler help contract in isolated test fixtures. The standalone help case uses a temporary non-runtime root, so the baseline cannot touch a real client home.
redCandidate.expected: Every lifecycle command accepts and forwards an explicit --adopt-legacy-superpowers request while defaults remain false; the standalone reconciler documents dry-run-before-adoption and rejects unknown options without reconciling.
redCandidate.observed: The command exited 1 with seven focused failures: init parsing and dispatch reject or drop the option, setup/update drop it, lifecycle adapters do not forward it, init help omits it, and the standalone reconciler emits no help and ignores unknown options.
redCandidate.failureReason: The reconciliation domain has an explicit safe adoption capability, but the public lifecycle and standalone CLI contracts neither expose nor reliably propagate it.
